game.title: The Surge 2
game.blurb: Sci-fi action RPG from Deck13 and Focus Home Interactive (as RAWG lists them), released 2019-09-24. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones and bosses across the city, as hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Directional blocks, headshots, limb cuts, drone tricks, drowning foes, cloaked Hunters and boss rewards.

chapters.title: Gear, Crafting and Tech Scrap
chapters.summary: Equipping and upgrading gear sets and weapons, crafting, Core Power and spending or carrying tech scrap.

chapters.title: Visions, Echoes and Secrets
chapters.summary: Strange Visions, the Delver Echoes, Gideon's Rock statues and slipping past A.I.D. checkpoint gates.

chapters.title: The Kraken DLC
chapters.summary: The Kraken add-on: its pirates, robotic crabs, gear sets and hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "The Surge 2" or "The Surge II". thesurge.fandom.com answers the API under "The Surge 2" with about 29 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 29 of 57 Steam achievements are hidden (API names ACHV_01 to ACHV_57 in list order). The last visible ones (crabs, the pirate on the plank, "Crafted all gear sets of the Kraken DLC") sit at positions 50, 55 and 57, and the hidden ones at positions 47 to 56 all have low unlock rates (3.0% to 7.6%), so those 8 hidden ones were put in the Kraken chapter as a guess from position; the other 21 hidden ones sit in the story chapter, including some (for example "Counter-Sniper", "What A Catchy Song") that may be side quests rather than story. The "Kraken" name comes from the achievement text; RAWG also lists a season pass and a URBN Gear Pack.
